questions.stem: 我以前很怕說英文，後來才發現在語言交換應用程式（app）上聊天很有趣。
questions.answer: I used to be afraid of speaking English, but later found that chatting on a language exchange app was fun.
accepted_answers: I used to be scared of speaking English, but I later realized that chatting on language exchange apps was interesting.
I used to be afraid to speak English, but later I discovered that it was fun to chat on language exchange apps.

questions.stem: 每天十分鐘的視訊聊天，讓我更了解母語人士怎麼表達想法。
questions.answer: A ten-minute video chat every day helps me understand better how native speakers express their ideas.
accepted_answers: A daily ten-minute video chat helps me better understand how native speakers express their thoughts.
Thanks to a ten-minute video chat every day, I now understand better how native speakers express themselves.

patterns: 複合形容詞（數字-名詞單數）

1.explanation_zh: 「以前很怕…（現在不怕了）」是過去的狀態，用 used to + 原形動詞：I used to be afraid of speaking English（afraid 是形容詞，前面要有 be）；不要和 be used to + V-ing（習慣於）混淆。「後來才發現…」接名詞子句：later I found (that) …。that 子句的主詞是「在語言交換 app 上聊天」這個動作，用動名詞 chatting on language exchange apps，或改用虛主詞 it was fun to chat …；「有趣」用 fun／interesting，不是 funny。
1.strategy_zh: 「以前…（現在不再）」先想 used to + VR；「發現／認為／相信＋一件事」後面接 that 子句。
hints: 切成四段：我以前很怕說英文／後來才發現／在語言交換應用程式（app）上聊天／很有趣
標的詞彙：afraid（害怕的）、speak（說）、find（發現；過去式 found）、chat（聊天）、exchange（交換）、fun（有趣的事）
句型框架：S + used to + be + adj. …, but later S + found (that) + V-ing … + was + adj.

2.explanation_zh: 「十分鐘的視訊聊天」用複合形容詞 a ten-minute video chat：數字和名詞用連字號連起來，名詞用單數 minute，前面加冠詞 a；「每天」every day 放在名詞後面（或寫 a daily ten-minute video chat）。「讓我更了解…」是 help me understand better（也可 better understand）。「母語人士怎麼表達想法」是間接問句，要用直述句語序 how native speakers express their ideas，不能寫成 how do native speakers express …。
evidence: 每天十分鐘的視訊聊天
母語人士怎麼表達想法
2.strategy_zh: 「數字＋單位＋的＋名詞」先想 a + 數字-名詞（單數）+ N；間接問句裡的疑問詞後面一律接「主詞＋動詞」。
hints: 切成四段：每天／十分鐘的視訊聊天／讓我更了解／母語人士怎麼表達想法
標的詞彙：day（天；every day）、minute（分鐘）、video（視訊）、chat（聊天）、understand（了解）、native（母語的；native speaker）、express（表達）
句型框架：A + 數字-名詞 + N … helps me understand better + how + S + V …

references: I used to be afraid of speaking English, but later found that chatting on a language exchange app was fun.
I used to be scared of speaking English, but I later realized that chatting on language exchange apps was interesting.
I used to be afraid to speak English, but later I discovered that it was fun to chat on language exchange apps.

patterns.label_zh: used to＋原形動詞（以前…，現在不再）
that 名詞子句（當 found 的受詞）

accepted: I used to be afraid of speaking English
I used to be scared of speaking English
I used to be afraid to speak English
I used to be afraid of speaking in English
I used to fear speaking English
I was afraid of speaking English before

common_errors.wrong: I used to afraid of speaking English
common_errors.right: I used to be afraid of speaking English
common_errors.explanation_zh: afraid 是形容詞，used to 後面要先接原形 be。

common_errors.wrong: I was used to be afraid of speaking English
common_errors.right: I used to be afraid of speaking English
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「以前…」是 used to + 原形動詞；be used to + V-ing 是「習慣於」。

common_errors.wrong: I used to be afraid of speak English
common_errors.right: I used to be afraid of speaking English
common_errors.explanation_zh: 介系詞 of 後面接動名詞 speaking。
「後來」是副詞 later／then；after 是連接詞或介系詞，後面要接子句或名詞。
「後來才發現」是過去的事，用過去式 found。

parts.zh: 在語言交換應用程式（app）上聊天
accepted: chatting on a language exchange app
to chat on language exchange apps
chatting with people on language exchange apps
talking to people on language exchange apps
using language exchange apps to chat

common_errors.wrong: chat on language exchange apps was
common_errors.right: chatting on language exchange apps was
common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作當主詞要用動名詞 chatting（或用 it was fun to chat …）。
「語言交換」是名詞修飾名詞 language exchange，不寫 exchanging。
funny 是「好笑的」；「有趣、好玩」用 fun 或 interesting。

traps.literal_error: I used to afraid speak English, but later I found that …
traps.explanation_zh: afraid 是形容詞，used to 後面要先接 be；「怕做某事」是 afraid of + V-ing 或 afraid to + VR。

traps.zh: 在語言交換應用程式（app）上聊天很有趣
traps.literal_error: I used to be afraid of speaking English, but later I found on language exchange apps chat was very funny.
traps.explanation_zh: that 子句的主詞是「在 app 上聊天」這個動作，要用動名詞 chatting on language exchange apps，不能照中文先寫地點再接原形動詞。

1.restructuring_zh: that 子句的主詞是「在語言交換 app 上聊天」這個動作，英文用動名詞 chatting on language exchange apps 當主詞，或用虛主詞 it was fun to chat …。

references: A ten-minute video chat every day helps me understand better how native speakers express their ideas.
A daily ten-minute video chat helps me better understand how native speakers express their thoughts.
Thanks to a ten-minute video chat every day, I now understand better how native speakers express themselves.

patterns.label_zh: 複合形容詞（數字-名詞單數：ten-minute）
patterns.frame: a + 數字-名詞（單數）+ N（a ten-minute video chat）
S + V + how + S + V（直述句語序）

common_errors.explanation_zh: 副詞「每天」要分開寫 every day；連在一起的 everyday 是形容詞（日常的）。
「數字－名詞」當形容詞時名詞用單數，中間加連字號：ten-minute。
ten minutes 不能直接放在名詞前面當形容詞；寫成 a ten-minute video chat 或 ten minutes of video chatting。
「更了解」是 understand better 或 better understand，不說 more understand。
使役動詞 make 後面接原形動詞，不加 to。

parts.zh: 母語人士怎麼表達想法
accepted: how native speakers express their ideas
how native speakers express their thoughts
how native English speakers express their ideas
the way native speakers express their ideas

common_errors.wrong: how do native speakers express their ideas
common_errors.right: how native speakers express their ideas
common_errors.explanation_zh: 間接問句用直述句語序（how + 主詞 + 動詞），不加助動詞 do。

common_errors.wrong: how mother language people express their ideas
common_errors.right: how native speakers express their ideas
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「母語人士」是 native speakers，不逐字翻成 mother language people。

traps.zh: 每天十分鐘的視訊聊天
traps.literal_error: Every day ten minutes video chat lets me more understand native speakers how to express ideas.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把「每天」「十分鐘的」都放在名詞前面；英文用複合形容詞 a ten-minute video chat（minute 用單數），every day 放在後面。

traps.literal_error: A ten-minute video chat every day lets me more understand how native speakers express their ideas.
traps.explanation_zh: 「更了解」是 understand better／better understand，more 不能直接放在動詞前面。

warnings: annotations.rubric.items.2: 首選參考譯文有詞彙表外的字 ['ten-minute']（表外專有名詞請在題目括號附英文）

1.translation: I used to be afraid of speaking English, but later I found that chatting on a language exchange app was a lot of fun.
1.explanation_zh: 「以前很怕」用 used to 表過去習慣狀態；「後來才發現」用 but later I found that；「在 app 上聊天」是動作當主詞，用動名詞 chatting；「很有趣」此處是好玩之意，用 a lot of fun。

2.translation: A ten-minute video chat every day has helped me better understand how native speakers express their ideas.
2.explanation_zh: 「每天十分鐘的視訊聊天」當主詞，用 a ten-minute video chat every day（複合形容詞 ten-minute 不加 s）；「讓我更了解」用 help me (to) understand；「怎麼表達想法」用間接問句 how native speakers express their ideas（直述語序）。

1.translation: I used to be afraid of speaking English, but later I found out that chatting on a language exchange app was a lot of fun.
1.explanation_zh: 「以前很怕」用 used to be afraid of + V-ing；「後來才發現」用 later I found out that，從屬子句與過去時間一致用過去式；「語言交換應用程式」用 language exchange app。

2.translation: Chatting by video for ten minutes every day helps me better understand how native speakers express their ideas.
2.explanation_zh: 「視訊聊天」用 chatting by video 當動名詞主詞；「讓我更了解」用 help me better understand；「怎麼表達想法」用 how native speakers express their ideas。時態用現在簡單式表習慣，也可以用現在完成式。

issues_zh: 標的句型 BASIC（gp-compound-adj：a ten-minute video chat）沒有被中文自然引出：「每天十分鐘的視訊聊天」我自然譯成 Chatting by video for ten minutes every day，沒有用數字加單數名詞的複合形容詞；第 2 部分 accepted 自己也收了 ten minutes of video chatting，表示中文並不要求複合形容詞。建議把中文改成更強的提示（例如「一場十分鐘的視訊通話」），或把 BASIC 從這一句的標的句型拿掉。

problems: 第 2 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['BASIC']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）

status_reason: blind_solver:B 未通過：第 2 題盲譯沒有用到標的句型 ['BASIC']：中文題目沒有自然引出這個句型（SPEC §5.7）；判定者人工審查（第 1 輪）：同意退回。第 2 題標的句型 BASIC（複合形容詞 a ten-minute video chat）沒有被中文唯一引出：「每天十分鐘的視訊聊天」當主詞同樣自然譯成動名詞片語 Chatting by video for ten minutes every day（驗證者 B）或 Video chatting for ten minutes every day，第 2 部分 accepted 本身也收了不是複合形容詞的 ten minutes of video chatting，標的句型和評分規準互相矛盾；B 的動名詞主詞寫法又不在第 2 部分 accepted 內，規準也偏窄。重生時改寫中文讓「數字－名詞」複合形容詞成為唯一自然的寫法（例如讓「一場十分鐘的視訊通話」當受詞），或把這一句的標的句型換成中文確實會逼出來的句構，並補齊動名詞主詞的可接受寫法。第 1 題沒有問題。
